primary_purpose: Correct a common development or testing mistake with actionable advice
required_sections: HOOK: Call out a common anti-pattern (e.g., poor state management in React)
PROBLEM: Why this approach fails at scale or causes bugs
STEPS: 3 concrete, actionable steps to implement the fix
TAKEAWAY: The business or performance value of this fix
tone_rules: Focus on clean code, scalability, or QA automation best practices
Do not use generic advice; be specific to modern stacks
